admission.justification: Operation and installer order must agree so new users do not invoke a foundation writer on an unborn memory line.

applicability: First-hour bootstrap/install procedure for newly initialized memory with no commit.
conditions: The existing fixer produces initial converted onboarding before attributed adoption.
The foundation uses the baseline commit and is authored by the curator through its own route.
Memory that already has a commit may reach its foundation before onboarding/adoption.
exclusions: Making onboarding mandatory for every foundation.
A fabricated task, leaf or enclosure as a foundation prerequisite.
Bootstrap seat authoring knowledge or owning ordinary Git/closeout transactions.

evidence: mcp/tests/test_bootstrap_converted_onboarding.py::test_bootstrap_skill_texts_state_the_fixer_and_the_order; composed journey test (init, cards, fixer, status, adopt, reads, refusal)

statement: A new repository runs memory_init, first onboarding with the fixer, baseline adoption, then the knowledge foundation, which needs the baseline commit; only a memory that already has a commit may run the foundation earlier.
